title: Spring questions for a small harbour

exploration.question: How does the harbour keep a ferry sailing through the winter

branches.prompt: Where does the ferry tie up when the harbour ices over
branches.finding: The ferry ties up at the north pontoon when the harbour ices over

branches.prompt: What fuel does the boat burn in the cold months
branches.finding: The boat burns winter grade diesel drawn from the town depot

branches.prompt: How often does the boat sail in January
Where is the winter diesel stored ashore
branches.finding: Two heated tanks stand behind the harbour office

branches.prompt: Where does the crew rest between sailings in the thaw
Who watches the ice at the harbour mouth

exploration.question: Who answers a call for help on the water in the thaw

branches.prompt: How does a call for help reach the lifeboat crew
How does the boat get down the slipway on ice
branches.finding: The slipway is gritted and the tractor is kept fuelled

branches.prompt: What seas can the boat go out in
branches.reason: The spring drill rota settles the outing limits

branches.prompt: How does the crew get word back to shore
branches.reason: The radio drill in the spring log already answers this

exploration.question: How does the harbour report the ice each morning

branches.prompt: Where is the morning ice report posted
What does the ice gauge read at the pier head
branches.finding: The gauge at the pier head is read at first light
